bio: Run with great dedication in the heart of the old Rohrbach district, this lovely traditional restaurant has a cosy interior featuring a blend of traditional and modern elements. Chef Ole Hake's ambitious dishes are made with carefully selected regional ingredients, for example excellent game. His commitment to sustainability is palpable. The seasonal seven-course set menu comes in an omnivore or vegan version. There is also a well-curated wine list with an emphasis on German labels. These can also be enjoyed in the wine bar with snacks or a light meal. Tip for motorists: the public car park at the nearby Thorax Clinic is convenient....
